title: streamline-release-hooks-and-deps-pruning
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: our monorepo CI has accumulated heavyweight release hooks and loosely pinned GH Action dependencies that increase latency and surface for unexpected breaks. This PR splits the monolithic release workflow into a minimal fast-path (release-prepare) and a gated publish job, prunes unused third-party actions, pins critical actions to SHAs, and adds a path-filtered job matrix to limit lint/test runs to impacted packages. Changes are backwards compatible: default release behavior unchanged, but CI runtime reduced and surface area for failures narrowed. Checklist: [x] split release workflow, [x] add publish gating and dry-run mode, [x] prune/replace deprecated actions, [x] pin actions to SHAs or internal mirrors, [x] add path-based matrix for package-level jobs, [x] update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md and release playbook. Testing notes: validated on fork for three representative release cases (patch, minor with manifests, and canary), ran full monorepo CI once to ensure opt-in matrix coverage, smoke-tested publish with dry-run to our staging artifact registry. Rollback plan: revert this branch (small surface) or flip RELEASE_GATING=false in repo settings to restore original behavior. Related Linear: ENG-3241, ENG-3289. Related Jira: SUP-1123 (customer incident that motivated pinning actions).
commits: refactor(ci): split release workflow into release-prepare and release-publish jobs
ci: add path-filtered matrix to only run package lint/test on changed packages
ci: prune actions (remove actions/checkout v1 usage and unmaintained publish action), replace with lightweight internal scripts
ci: pin key actions to commit SHAs and add mirror fallback for marketplace outages
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md with new release and CI guidance
files_changed: .github/workflows/release.yml (replaced by two lightweight workflows: release-prepare.yml + release-publish.yml)
.github/workflows/ci-test.yml (split unit/integration paths and added conditional integration on labels)
.github/actions/internal-publish/action.yml (new, small wrapper around our publish tooling)
tools/ci/filter_changed_packages.sh (helper used by job matrix to compute matrix_json)
CONTRIBUTING.md (docs on release steps and dry-run flag)
ci_checks: lint: pass (path-filtered matrix validated for 6 changed packages)
integration-tests: flaky on first run (known flaky: test/integration/kvcache), rerun and passed

release_notes: Reduced CI runtime and attack surface for release failures by splitting release workflows, pinning critical GH Actions, and limiting lint/test runs to changed packages. No functional product changes.
